name: ESET PROTECT
summary: ESET PROTECT is a subscription suite with antivirus, a cloud or on-premises management console and an optional extended detection and response module built on ESET Inspect. Plans are billed per year. ESET's US plans page showed a $216.00 figure beside the Premium plan, but it did not state the unit, so we list no price. Guided onboarding and 24/7 managed detection are part of Premium.

facts.text: ESET says you can deploy and manage security through an ESET cloud console or an on-premises console, and recommends the cloud console.
ESET's documentation says the web console lets an administrator quickly respond to detected threats on remote systems.
The Extended Detection and Response module uses ESET Inspect and needs an activated ESET PROTECT.
The plans page lists ESET PROTECT Core and Premium, billed per year, and Premium includes 24/7 managed detection and response.
